headline: High: Airbyte’s broad egress plus business-data handling creates default leakage/compliance risk; prompt-injection and conflict risks are lower because ai-engineering-hub is non-runnable and has no I/O surfaces.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No plausible default injection bridge is documented. agent_a has no io_surfaces and is marked runnable:false, while agent_b only exposes Airbyte API calls and broad egress. Without a shared channel or a runnable path from A into B, prompt injection is not evidenced.
conditions: IF agent_a is made runnable and its outputs are copied into agent_b inputs, injection risk becomes plausible.
IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between them, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep agent_a non-runnable.
Do not pipe agent_a text into agent_b prompts.
Disable any shared clipboard or workspace bridge.
Add provenance tags before any manual transfer.
requires-engineering: add input sanitization and instruction stripping.

B_data_leakage.rationale: agent_b touches business data and has broad network egress, so if it receives data from agent_a or a shared workspace, leakage can occur in default use. agent_a touches no data classes and has no egress, but the pair still creates a one-way exposure path through B’s outbound connectivity.
conditions: IF agent_a outputs are copied into agent_b jobs, business data may leave the local boundary.
IF agent_b is configured to sync or export its context to external services, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Restrict agent_b to approved destinations only.
Avoid passing agent_a outputs into agent_b unless redacted.
Separate workspaces for the two agents.
Review Airbyte connector destinations before runs.
requires-engineering: enforce DLP and egress allowlists.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write surface is documented. agent_a has no io_surfaces and is non-runnable, while agent_b only calls the Airbyte API. That makes direct write contention unlikely; uncertainty remains because the profiles do not fully describe deployment locking.
conditions: IF both agents are later given write access to the same directory or API resource, conflict risk rises.
IF an orchestrator removes locking around shared mutable state, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep write scopes separate.
Use distinct API credentials.
Avoid shared mutable workspaces.
Serialize any shared updates manually.
requires-engineering: add resource locking or optimistic concurrency control.

D_cascading_error.rationale: agent_b can act on data pipelines and has broad egress, so if it treats agent_a output as authoritative, errors can propagate into downstream transfers. agent_a is a docs-only, non-runnable source here, which lowers but does not remove the risk because the pair still supports unverified handoff from A to B.
conditions: IF agent_a-generated text is used as configuration or mapping input for agent_b, cascading errors become likely.
IF agent_b executes actions without a validation step, blast radius increases.
mitigations: Require human review before execution.
Validate schemas before importing outputs.
Use test runs for any transferred configuration.
Keep agent_a outputs as drafts only.
requires-engineering: add automated verification gates.

E_compliance.rationale: agent_b touches business data and has broad egress, creating a plausible compliance mismatch if regulated or residency-bound data is routed through it. agent_a has no data classes touched, so it is not the compliance driver; the risk is concentrated in B’s outbound handling and unspecified retention/residency controls.
conditions: IF EU PII or other regulated data is routed through agent_b without a DPA or residency controls, compliance risk rises.
IF retention or deletion requirements apply to business data processed by agent_b, reassess upward.
mitigations: Classify data before routing.
Block regulated data from agent_b until controls are confirmed.
Document residency and retention settings.
Review vendor terms for Airbyte destinations.
requires-engineering: implement policy-based routing and retention enforcement.
